_readme: Deployment settings consumed by `pac solution import --settings-file` for PRD.
This file is NOT the provisioning settings file: the PowerShell scripts in
Purpose (C-TECH-031 / C-TECH-047): the managed solution carries environment
variable DEFINITIONS and connection REFERENCES with no values; every
per-environment value is injected here at import time.
Identifiers only — never a secret (C-TECH-001). Replace every {{PLACEHOLDER}}.
ConnectionId values only exist after the service account has created the three
connections interactively, which requires the WBS 0.3 Conditional Access
exception to be in place for that account.

EnvironmentVariables._comment: The process owner's own mailbox. Teams notifications go to a 1:1 chat, not a channel, because the new-application notification carries an applicant name (TAD ADR-015).

Recipient of the Capture Payment flow's Teams message when a final payment cannot be applied (FR-111, wbs:8.6, ADR-081). PRD carries the process owner for now (a combined role today, likely split later); only this value changes when it splits.
Outlook fallback address used when the Teams connector is unavailable (TAD §4).
Entra application (client) ID of the live WordPress caller. Only required under the Entra-OAuth intake route (Dev Summary §7, decision D-1).

Name of the DocuSign Connect configuration the acceptance completion trigger registers on the DocuSign account. One per environment so each registration can be told apart in DocuSign Admin; not an identifier or secret, so it is a literal value.
